scripts.db:init: pnpm build:dbtool && dotnet run --project apps/api/tools/FlowPilot.DatabaseTool/FlowPilot.DatabaseTool.csproj -c Release --no-build --no-restore --no-launch-profile -- initialize
scripts.db:seed: pnpm build:dbtool && dotnet run --project apps/api/tools/FlowPilot.DatabaseTool/FlowPilot.DatabaseTool.csproj -c Release --no-build --no-restore --no-launch-profile -- seed
scripts.db:verify: pnpm build:dbtool && dotnet run --project apps/api/tools/FlowPilot.DatabaseTool/FlowPilot.DatabaseTool.csproj -c Release --no-build --no-restore --no-launch-profile -- verify
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @process-site/api-contract build && pnpm restore:api && dotnet build apps/api/FlowPilot.slnx -c Release --no-restore -m:1 && pnpm --filter @process-site/web build
scripts.build:api: pnpm restore:api && dotnet build apps/api/FlowPilot.slnx -c Release --no-restore -m:1
scripts.publish:api: dotnet publish apps/api/src/FlowPilot.Api/FlowPilot.Api.csproj -c Release -r win-x64 --self-contained false -m:1 -p:RestoreLockedMode=true --output apps/api/artifacts/publish
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @process-site/api-contract build && pnpm restore:api && dotnet build apps/api/FlowPilot.slnx -c Release --no-restore -m:1 && pnpm --filter @process-site/web typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @process-site/api-contract build && pnpm test:api && pnpm --filter @process-site/web test
scripts.test:api: pnpm build:api && pnpm test:api:unit && pnpm test:api:http && pnpm test:api:sql
scripts.backend:check: pnpm contract:check && pnpm restore:api && dotnet build apps/api/FlowPilot.slnx -c Release --no-restore -m:1 && dotnet run --project apps/api/tests/FlowPilot.UnitTests/FlowPilot.UnitTests.csproj -c Release --no-build --no-restore -- --minimum-expected-tests 1 && dotnet run --project apps/api/tests/FlowPilot.ApiTests/FlowPilot.ApiTests.csproj -c Release --no-build --no-restore -- --minimum-expected-tests 1 && pnpm test:api:sql:required
